documentation.content: YouTube owner 事件驅動鏈（Workflow youtube-owner-chain）執行失敗。到 Workflows → youtube-owner-chain → Executions 打開失敗的那次，看是哪一步出錯。處理方式見 orchestration/README.md。

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/Workflow" AND resource.labels.workflow_id = "youtube-owner-chain" AND metric.type = "workflows.googleapis.com/finished_execution_count" AND metric.labels.status = "FAILED"
